description: Reproducible scale for the four-node technical Ising scenario; model time and laptop work are distinct from physical house heat.
workUnit: one 32x32 Ising simulation at one temperature and seed
jobTasksSource: docs/jobs/research-sim.md: 16 temperatures x 2 seeds in a parameter scan; this demo executes 32 real tasks, not a customer demand trace.
measuredDevice: Intel Core Ultra 7 255H laptop, Windows 11, Docker Desktop Linux container, 0.5 CPU quota, one calibration worker; 2026-11-21
measurementCommand: docker run --rm --cpus 0.5 -e TARGET_SECONDS=4 -e PROBE_SWEEPS=5000 digitalheat/research-sim:live-demo calibrate
display: The UI caps waiting tokens per house at 14 and shows a +N count. A token is a real task file; no completed task is invented or merely animated.
referenceHeatCaveat: The case's 1 kW reference server and 80% recovery are simulation inputs. CPU quota and this laptop's measured task time do not measure electric power or recovered heat.
customerDemandCaveat: 32 tasks is the documented technical research scan, not evidence of 32 paid customer tasks or a real deadline. The catalog Type 2 job has no deadline; this is a separate synthetic deadline-bearing demonstration scenario.
